observations.title: A Pay route test already exercises the unknown-attempt clear button
observations.detail: The rejection/retry route test looks up and clicks the explicit clear button, unlike WalletAttempts component tests that manually provide wallet props. Privacy branch wiring reviewed in wave 2 omits the wallet prop, so preserve/adapt this route-level assertion when fixing PS2-01. No test was run and no runtime result is claimed.

observations.title: Policy send guard tests do not model editing the mounted PolicyPay form
observations.detail: The fixture intentionally captures only captureSessionVersionGuard plus a review snapshot, mirroring PolicyPay. Tests cover explicit session changes and modified captured bytes, but not a mounted PolicyPay input edit that leaves the captured guard alive. A UI integration regression test is the relevant acceptance evidence for PS2-04. Policy remains inactive without pinned deployment; no separate production issue asserted.
